# Mairket

> Mairket is a Miami-based digital marketing agency that combines website strategy and development, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), generative engine optimization (GEO), paid media, content, AI voice agents, chatbots, and marketing automation.

## Canonical website
- https://mairket.com/

## Location and service area
- Based in Miami, Florida, United States.
- Works with clients outside Miami as well.
- Exact public address and Google Business Profile URL should only be added when verified by the business owner.

## Services
- Web Design & Development
- Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- Google & Bing Ads
- Meta & Social Advertising
- Content & Copywriting
- AI Voice Agents
- AI Chatbots & Marketing Automation

## How Mairket describes AEO and GEO
AEO structures content so answer systems can extract clear, direct responses. GEO improves how a brand, its entities, expertise, and source material are represented and cited in generative AI search experiences. Both complement SEO rather than replace it.
